python3 -B - <<'PY'
import sys,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import public_check
# This development container inherited stricter hard CPU/AS limits than those
# requested by the public child harness. Do not relax any limit: clamp those two
# requests to the already-enforced hard ceilings for a supplementary local run.
real=resource.setrlimit
def bounded_setrlimit(kind, limits):
    hard=resource.getrlimit(kind)[1]
    if hard!=resource.RLIM_INFINITY:
        limits=tuple(min(n,hard) if n!=resource.RLIM_INFINITY else hard for n in limits)
    real(kind,limits)
resource.setrlimit=bounded_setrlimit
sys.argv=['/workspace/public_check.py','/workspace/submission']
raise SystemExit(public_check.main())
PY
